boundaries.payment-gateway: NOT_RUN (no external payment provider in scope)

checks.invariant: E2E-FS-01 inventory conservation under 50 concurrent attempts
checks.detail: MaxDegreeOfParallelism equals the attempt count, so the requests genuinely race instead of being serialised

checks.invariant: E2E-FS-02 one order per idempotency key
E2E-FS-03 reserve -> queue -> consume converges to one order
E2E-FS-04 consumer dies mid-flight, then recovers
checks.expected: zero orders while unprocessed, then exactly one order
checks.detail: asserts the intermediate state: a killed consumer must leave zero orders, not a compensating fake one

checks.invariant: E2E-FS-05 backup -> corrupt -> restore recovers the invariant
checks.expected: PASS before, FAIL after corruption, PASS after restore
checks.actual: before= PASS after_mutation= FAIL after_restore= PASS
checks.detail: pg_dump -Fc plus pg_restore --clean --if-exists against a real postgres:15-alpine whose schema came from the repository's own EF migrations. Plain 'pg_dump | psql' was tried first and silently failed to recover, because every CREATE INDEX hit 'already exists'.

notes: Zero oversell, idempotency, async queue flow and consumer recovery, all against real infrastructure. Payment gateway and Azure Service Bus remain unexercised.
